name: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India (PM-YASASVI)
description: Scholarship scheme by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment for OBC, EBC, and DNT students studying in Class 9 to 12 and higher education.
documents: Mark sheet of previous qualifying exam

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students
description: Financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families to meet a part of their day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students
description: Financial assistance to Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their education.
documents: Income Certificate issued by competent authority

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students
description: Scholarship provided by AICTE to empower girl students pursuing technical education in approved degree or diploma institutions.
documents: Admission letter to AICTE approved technical institution
Bank Account details linked with Aadhaar

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
description: Awarded to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest their drop out at class 8 and encourage them to continue study at secondary stage.

name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Merit Scholarship (Maharashtra)
description: State scholarship by Maharashtra Government providing financial assistance to EWS and General category students pursuing higher professional education.
documents: CAP Allotment Letter for professional course
Aadhaar Card linked with Bank Account
